references.text: Ehud had just sent away the people carrying the tribute, and now he returns alone to the king with a secret message.
The upper chamber (attic) is mentioned again when the servants find the door locked and assume that the king is covering his feet.
Samuel asks Saul to stop because he has a word from God for him, similar to how Ehud addresses Eglon with a divine message.
Eli was sitting on a chair by the doorpost and stood up when he heard news, in the same way that Eglon rose from his seat.
A cooling chamber (upper room with air conditioning) is mentioned as a private room, similar to Eglon's upper chamber where he sat alone.
The king was sitting in the winter house (upper room), and this was a private royal room similar to Eglon's cool attic.
